name: app-shater-craftsman-phone-with-onboarding-strip-and-verification-steps
title: Shater craftsman onboarding: a big glowing phone over five sequenced screens and a green-checked verification row
whatItIs: A near-identical companion slide to the craftsman onboarding spread: a large glowing phone held in a hand above a strip of five sequential app screens, and below, four verification steps ending in a green-checked 'account activated' state with an orange divider line and Arabic caption.
whatItMeans: Reinforcing; repeating the same verification story with a bigger hero phone emphasises the flow's importance.
techniques: Scale up the hero device for emphasis.
Keep the verification steps identical across slides for consistency.
Divide sections with a thin orange rule.

vocabulary.definition: The largest, most prominent screen mockup in a layout.
A thin line separating parts of a layout.
